description: Server-side PQ pins through authorize(): each case stores one grant (the resolver answers it by id), presents a signed PCActn and states the exact outcome. `pq_pins: null` means the option is not configured. Run with plan "single-step", the audience below, the clock below, a revocation hook that is enforced and ok, a zero risk, and a fresh replay store per case. The grant carries the signed provenance opt-out, so no provenance bundle is needed. Compared: allow, decision, status, that every check in `failed_includes` is among the failing checks (a wrong PQ pin also fails the own policy check of the chain in TypeScript, so the set is a lower bound; an allow has none), the pq_pin check status (`pass`, `fail`, or `absent` when it is not reported) and, on a denial, that the reason contains `expect.reason`. A native that cannot verify an ml-dsa-65 root hop must answer `unsupported_suite` rather than allow.

cases.name: pq-grant-pinned
cases.description: A pure ml-dsa-65 grant whose issuer is pinned to the grant pq_pk: allowed, pq_pin passes.

cases.name: pq-grant-no-pin-for-the-issuer
cases.description: The same grant with pins that name only another issuer: denied, naming the suite.

expect.reason: pq_pin: no server-side PQ pin for the grant issuer (suite ml-dsa-65)

cases.name: pq-grant-empty-pins
cases.description: The same grant with an empty pin map: denied (an empty map is still a configured pin set).

expect.reason: pq_pin: no server-side PQ pin for the grant issuer (suite ml-dsa-65)

cases.name: pq-grant-pin-of-another-suite
cases.description: The issuer is pinned to an ML-DSA-87 key: not the grant pq_pk, denied.

expect.reason: pq_pin: the grant pq_pk does not match the server-side pin

cases.name: pq-grant-pin-is-a-prefix
cases.description: The pin is only the first 20 characters of the grant pq_pk: byte-equality, denied.

expect.reason: pq_pin: the grant pq_pk does not match the server-side pin

cases.name: pq-grant-pins-omitted
cases.description: pq_pins not configured at all: the check is not reported and the stored grant is the root (allowed).

cases.name: classical-grant-from-a-pinned-issuer-is-refused
cases.description: DOWNGRADE: an Ed25519 grant naming an issuer that has a PQ pin is refused (otherwise anyone holding the issuer Ed25519 key would mint a grant the pin never sees). The principal here holds both keys: the pin is keyed by the Ed25519 issuer identity, which a classical grant carries.

expect.reason: pq_pin: the grant issuer is pinned to a post-quantum key; a classical grant is refused

cases.name: classical-grant-from-an-unpinned-issuer-passes
cases.description: An Ed25519 grant whose issuer has no pin (the pins name another issuer) is allowed: no PQ key to pin.

cases.name: classical-grant-empty-pins
cases.description: An Ed25519 grant with an empty pin map (no issuer is pinned): allowed.
